preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer N where 1 ≤ N ≤ 1000.
Each of the N commands has a length of at most 100 characters.
Each command ends with a period.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' not in line[0] and ' ' not in line[-1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: No command line contains leading or trailing spaces.

preconditions.expression: all('Simon says' in line.split()[:2] or 'Simon says' not in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: If a command begins with 'Simon says', it is exactly the first two words; otherwise, it does not contain 'Simon says'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == (line[len('Simon says '):] if line.startswith('Simon says ') else '') for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if line.startswith('Simon says '))
postconditions.description: For each command that begins with 'Simon says ', the output line is the rest of the command after 'Simon says ' (including the leading space).

postconditions.expression: all(line not in stdout for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if not line.startswith('Simon says '))
postconditions.description: Commands that do not begin with 'Simon says ' are not included in the output.
